OBTIME001.name: Canonical market schedule identity
OBTIME001.rule: A market schedule is explicit, timezone-aware, calendar-source bound, and tamper evident.

OBTIME002.name: Canonical time receipt
OBTIME002.rule: One aware observation instant is normalized to UTC and exchange-local time.

OBTIME003.name: Market-session classification
OBTIME003.rule: PREMARKET, REGULAR, AFTER_HOURS, and CLOSED are derived from the bound schedule rather than caller claims.

OBTIME004.name: Temporal validity binding
OBTIME004.rule: Existing temporal-validity authority consumes the verified market-time receipt for current date and session.

OBTIME005.name: Integrity and safety boundary
OBTIME005.rule: Time receipts are tamper evident and cannot create execution, broker, capital, or mode-unlock authority.

purpose: Replace caller-authored current session and trading-date inputs with a schedule-bound, timezone-aware canonical market-time receipt.
title: Canonical Market Time + Session Authority
